> OGDS AI Components — Plain-text agent protocol
> Free to browse and download. Component markup and metadata are original works; ogds-* class names and component CSS are from the Open Government Design System (ogds-elements), used under its license.
> Home: https://github.com/ednark/ogds-ai-components
> Base layer: https://github.com/ednark/ai-component-registry-spec (submodule at _base/)

---

## Overview

Open Government Design System registry for AI coding agents. ogds-elements is a
Lit web-component implementation of USWDS 3.x patterns styled with @ogds/tokens.
This registry tiles its components as self-contained static HTML: the flattened
rendered DOM of each component (shadow-DOM content with slot content realized),
with the component's derived light-DOM CSS inlined so tiles render standalone.
26 tiles across 8 component families, with categorized adaptation, coordination,
and compliance metadata (Section 508, WCAG 2.1 AA).

The canonical consumption path is the `<ogds-*>` web component itself — named
per tile in `ogdsElement`. Static tiles are the no-framework path and the
adaptation baseline.

## Machine manifest

> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/ogds-ai-components/main/agents.json

1. Fetch `agents.json` — count, facet vocabulary, URL patterns
2. Fetch `infinite/facets.json` — filter values (tiny)
3. Fetch `infinite/components.index.json` — lean index; filter IN CODE
4. Fetch only the tiles you need: `infinite/{component}/{variant}.html`
5. Parse the `ogds-agent-meta` JSON block inside each tile
6. Standalone appearance: fetch the sibling `.resolved.html` per tile

## Families

- accordion (5 tiles) — native details/summary disclosure shell
- accordion-toggle (2) — expand/collapse-all control for an accordion
- alert (6) — info / warning / success / error / slim / no-icon
- banner (4) — official-website identification banner (en/es, gov/mil)
- header (2) — extended and basic site header
- primary-nav (2) — responsive nav with details-based submenus
- task-list (1) + task-list-step (3) — progress list with status badges

## Version pin

This registry mirrors @ogds/elements@1.0.0-beta.2 (installed-package ground
truth). Ground-truth stylesheets are generated by tools/build-ground-truth.mjs
from the package's own stylesheets (mechanical :host/::slotted/::part
transform; class names unchanged) and vendored at infinite/ground-truth/.

## Conformance

node _base/validate-registry.mjs --conformance .
